title: Sanctions screening evidence and escalation workflow
workflow: Select legally applicable active sanctions lists for institution profile
Screen verified aliases, identifiers and corporate control parties as policy requires
Record candidate match and exact source edition and matching feature class
Block prohibited or unresolved actions under applicable policy while protecting case confidentiality
Let authorized compliance examiner classify evidence and escalate real matches
Retain immutable disposition, legal action and rescreen obligations
rules: Fuzzy matching is a candidate alert and never a legally conclusive sanctions designation
Never suppress an unresolved potential match because a workflow timer expired
Screening provider availability is not assumed; unavailable sources trigger fail-safe risk controls
Keep list licensing, effective date, jurisdiction and evidence freshness individually traceable
Do not expose sensitive suspicion or list investigations to unauthorized customer-facing channels
Regulated account blocking/rejection follows reviewed legal rules, not a globally hardcoded threshold
planned_test_cases: Unavailable source yields explicit pending screening state
Wrong list edition cannot support current approval
False-positive disposition records evidence and reviewer
acceptance_gate: Applicable sanctions instrument inventory, authorized screening sources and qualified compliance escalation procedures.
